# Wayforth — Academic & Research Advisory (wayforth.in)

> "Make Room for More."
> Accessible, dependable academic project, research report, and thesis advisory across undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral disciplines.

## Organization & Brand Facts
- Name: Wayforth Advisory
- Canonical Domain: https://wayforth.in
- Advisory Desk: info@wayforth.in | WhatsApp: +91 91571 88560
- Operating Model: 100% Genuine Human Research, Zero AI Regurgitation, Transparent Mathematical Pricing, Pay-As-You-Go Milestone Safeguards.

## Core Services & Academic Scope
1. **Undergraduate Project Advisory**: Capstone projects, term papers, lab monographs, accredited citations (APA, Harvard, IEEE). Standard 250–300 words/page. Base starting at ₹1,200 + ₹280/page.
2. **Postgraduate & MBA Consultancy**: Management capstones, corporate case studies, literature surveys, strategic framework synthesis. Base starting at ₹2,200 + ₹450/page.
3. **Data Analysis & Excel Projects**: Dynamic financial modeling (DCF, LBO), statistical hypothesis testing, automated formulas, high-resolution charts and appendices. Base starting at ₹2,500 + ₹380/page.
4. **Research Thesis & Doctoral Support**: Dissertations, MPhil/PhD proposals, systematic literature reviews (100+ peer sources), Zotero/Mendeley bibliographies, viva defense notes. Base starting at ₹4,200 + ₹620/page.

## Commercial Terms & Trust Safeguards
- **Pay-As-You-Go Milestone Model**: Work commences with a milestone deposit. No 100% upfront payment required. Full trust.
- **Watermarked Sample Preview**: Clients receive an authentic representative excerpt to inspect research caliber and formatting before settling the balance.
- **Included Revision**: 1 comprehensive revision round included within the agreed rubric scope (24-hour review window).
- **Zero Hidden Costs**: 15% introductory goodwill discount applied to transparent calculator estimates.

## Institutional Ethics & Academic Policy
- Wayforth provides editorial assistance, research frameworks, reference monographs, and quantitative models.
- **Grade Disclaimer**: Strictly no guarantee of academic grades, marks, or examination outcomes. Deliverables serve as high-standard educational reference materials to assist students in balancing demanding careers, internships, and coursework.
